name: down-south-ceylon
description: The Down South Ceylon blog — public site, articles API and editorial admin panel.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix admin
scripts.deploy: cross-env BASE_PATH=/the-blog/ npm run build --prefix frontend && gh-pages -d frontend/dist -m "Deploy blog to GitHub Pages"
